quote: Expiry: idle timeout AND absolute timeout (e.g. 4–8h for a full-day office app) regardless of activity (CWE-613), both computed from **server-side timestamps**, never from a time the client sends or a counter the client holds.
note: Section '## 2. Session management'; the same bullet gives idle ranges of 2-30 minutes, well inside the test's one-day bound.
